latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the citation-audit skill:
- Analyzes brand citation frequency across major AI platforms (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini)
- Identifies citation gaps and content opportunities (GEO-focused)
- Provides actionable reports including share of voice, competitor comparison, and prioritized recommendations
- Offers tiered packages and monthly monitoring for ongoing citation tracking
